# `csc`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
csc(expr)
```

Returns the cosecant of `expr`, as if computed by `1/java.lang.Math.sin`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT csc(1);
```

Result:

```text
1.1883951057781212
```
